basic_profile.bio: I'm a newbie to Reddit and a huge fan of Animal Crossing! I love trading items and exploring new communities on here. I live in Seattle and work as a freelance graphic designer. I'm usually online during the evenings after work, especially on weekends when I'm most active. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my downtime gaming or trying out new recipes. One thing I dislike is toxic behavior online; I'm all about keeping interactions positive and respectful.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied at a local community college. I stumbled upon Animal Crossing during the pandemic and have been hooked ever since. I learn a lot from YouTube tutorials and community forums, which help me improve both my gaming and design skills.
